answer_text: Lantern performs static and dynamic analysis of Android APK and AAB builds that the customer is authorized to test.
Dynamic analysis works on any IPA, including builds downloaded directly from the App Store.
Yes. Lantern performs GraphQL-specific testing, including introspection exposure and query-depth attacks.
Findings can be exported in SARIF 2.1.0, as well as JSON and CSV.
Lantern integrates natively with Jira Cloud, with two-way status sync between findings and issues.
A native ServiceNow integration will be available in Q3 2026.
SAML SSO is included in all Lantern plans.
Data retention is fixed at 12 months for all customers.
An on-premises deployment is available for Enterprise customers.
Customers can choose an EU (Frankfurt) or US region at tenant creation; tenant data stays in that region.
Lantern is ISO 27001 certified; the certificate is attached.
Our SOC 2 Type II report is available under NDA.
Our full third-party penetration test report is provided to any prospect on request.
Use the lantern CLI with --fail-on to gate pipelines. The API key is read from the LANTERN_API_KEY environment variable; store it as a masked CI secret.
Web scans authenticate with a recorded login sequence or a static bearer token. MFA-protected apps need a test account with MFA disabled or a bearer token.
Lantern guarantees detection of all OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities.
